ltc_discrepancy_resolution.explanation: The value 0.4264 belongs strictly to B3_RandomForest (mean Macro F1 across 5 folds). The value 0.4253 belongs strictly to B4_LightGBM (mean Macro F1 across 5 folds). In the Phase 5.3.2 fleet summary table, the column was labeled 'B4 Macro F1' which accurately reported 0.4253, while the comparative text correctly identified B3_RandomForest as having the highest Macro F1 at 0.4264. Both values are verified accurate and neither was corrupted.
